title: Unlock ladder (play beats)
kicker: Session and shell · how you play
hook: Layers on the rail **unlock as you play** — locked entries stay visible and tell you what opens them, instead of vanishing or sitting as dead grey weight.

blindSpots.meaning: A play milestone (first item, first demon you can fuse, first bound demon…). Not a music beat, not Dave’s level number.
The live order those beats open layers. Today this ladder is beat-based, not level-gated.
You can see the layer on the rail; you cannot use it yet. The UI should say what unlocks it.
A Vision drip of features by Dave’s level. Not what gates the live rail today — see [unlock chapters](unlock-chapters).

alsoTrue: This page is the **Shipped** rail. The Vision chapter table on How you play is separate fiction until a later program wires it.

sections.title: Live unlock table
sections.intro: What opens the rail in this build:

rows: You have a demon you can fuse
You have a bound demon to field

sections.note: Delve travel (Vision) unlocks when you have found a domain — not on this live table yet.

sections.title: Why beats, not a silent menu
paras: Invisible features teach nothing. Greyed icons with no reason teach frustration.
Beats keep the rail honest: you always know the next verb that will open a layer.

sections.title: What this is not
paras: It is not the Vision Dave-level chapter schedule (Dave 10 items, Dave 20 expeditions, and so on).
That chapter map will drip complexity by level later. Until then, play beats rule the rail you have now.

doSteps: Open the rail and find a locked layer.
Read the unlock hint on that entry.
Play until that beat happens, then open the layer once to feel it land.
doNote: Stop when locked entries feel like promises, not bugs. Optional Vision contrast: [unlock chapters](unlock-chapters).

mixUps.q: Why is Fusion locked when I have demons?
mixUps.a: You need a demon the lab can actually fuse. Owning a roster is not always enough.

mixUps.q: I hit Dave level 10 — where are Relics?
mixUps.a: Dave chapters are Vision. Relics open when you hold your first item (this page’s table).
No. It unlocks after your first run. Until then it should still show as locked with a reason.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as naming ritual?
mixUps.a: No. Naming ritual is a first-session WIP beat in the hall — see [naming ritual](naming-ritual).

mixUps.q: Will beats go away when chapters ship?
mixUps.a: Chapters are meant to drip complexity by Dave’s level. The product still wants clear unlock messaging either way.
